summary: The present petition has been filed by the Powerica Limited (hereinafter referred to as ‘Petitioner’) seeking relaxation of Regulation 22(3)(c) of the CERC (Indian Electricity Grid Code) Regulations, 2023 (hereinafter referred to as ‘Grid Code’) for permitting trial runs and commissioning of Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) in tranches of at least 10 MW for the Petitioner's 50 Wind Power Project (hereinafter referred to as ‘Project’). The Petitioner has made the following Prayers: - _(b) Direct the Respondents to permit the Petitioner to conduct trial run and commission its 50 MW wind power project situated in Villages Rentala Kalavad, Sajadiyali, Kantoliya, Gunda, Fot, in Taluka Bhanvad and Jam Khambaliya in District Devbhumi Dwarka, Gujarat in tranches of at least 10 MW._ - _(c) Pass such further/other Order(s) as this Commission may deem fit in the facts and circumstances of the case._ _“Learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the present Petition has been filed seeking relaxation of Regulation 22(3)(c) of the Indian Electricity Grid Code Regulations, 2023 for permitting the Petitioner to conduct trial runs and commissioning of the Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) in tranches of at least 10 MW for the Petitioner's 50 MW Wind Power Project at villages Rentala Kalavad, Sajadiyali, Kantoliya, Gunda, Fot, in Taluka Bhanvad and Jam Khambaliya in District Devbhumi Dwarka, Gujarat._ _2. Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission directed as under:_ _(b) The Respondents, to file their replies, if any, within six weeks with a copy to the Petitioner, who may file its rejoinders to the same within four weeks thereafter.”_ **4.** The Petitioner vide affidavit dated 22.09.2025 submitted that subsequent to the filing of the present Petition, certain further developments have taken place in the implementation of the Project, which are as under: _“At the outset, the learned counsel for the Petitioner, Powerica, submitted that it has filed an affidavit dated 23.9.2025 apprising the Commission about recent developments in respect of the implementation of the 50 MW Wind Power Project in Gujarat (the ‘Project’). Learned counsel further submitted that the Project is in the advanced stages and 13.5 MW will be ready for commissioning by 5.10.2025 and 37.8 MW by 15.10.2025. Learned counsel further submitted that the Petitioner has also obtained necessary approvals for the construction of the Project, along with CTUIL grid connectivity. Further, the buying entity, i.e., UPPCL, has also provided its consent for the off-taking of early commissioning of power from the Petitioner’s Project. Learned counsel, in light of the aforesaid developments, requested for deferment of the matter and to be listed again after 30.10.2025._ _2. The Petitioner was directed to submit on an affidavit within three weeks that under which clause of the PPA, the Petitioner is seeking part commissioning for a quantum less than 50 MW for the first part when the PPA permits first part only as 50 MW._ _3. Considering the above, the Commission acceded to the request of the Petitioner and decided to list the matter for the hearing on 25.11.2025.”_ - (b) The Petitioner vide letter dated 01.10.2025 sought No Objection Certificate from SECI and the Buying Entity, i.e., UPPCL, in the present case, for procurement of power of less than 50 MW capacity. In the said letter, the Petitioner has duly highlighted the reliefs sought in the present Petition and the reasons for the same, namely, the early commissioning of the 35 MW capacity of the Project and the risk of theft of conductors, if WTGs are left idle. _3. After considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the Petitioner and the representative of the Respondent, WRLDC, the Commission directed as under:_ _(i) The Petitioner to implead UPPCL as party to the Petition and to file a revised memo of parties within a day._ _(ii) The Petitioner to further submit the following information/clarification, on an affidavit, within three days:_ ## **Submissions of Petitioner in Compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 26.11.2025:** - (d) In compliance with the provisions of the PPA, the Petitioner has obtained all the necessary approvals, including the CEA Energisation Approval for 220/33 kV PSS and 19 WTGs, PTCC, and others. _“At the outset, the learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that, in compliance with the directions of the Commission vide Record of Proceedings for the hearing dated 26.11.2025, the Petitioner has impleaded UPPCL as a party to the Petition and filed the clarification/information as sought therein. The learned counsel pointed out that the start date of its connectivity is 31.12.2025 and thus, if the part commissioning of the 37.8 MW out of 50 MW is allowed, the Petitioner will be in a position to evacuate its power to this extent and mitigate its liability of transmission charges. The learned counsel further submitted that for the remaining 13.5 MW, the Petitioner is still facing the RoW issues, which are expected to be resolved by December 2025/January 2026. Learned counsel also stated that while the PPA/PSA provides for first part commissioning of a minimum 50 MW, SECI and UPPCL have, in this case, agreed to procure/off-take the power from less than 50 MW. Accordingly, the learned counsel sought indulgence of the Commission for relaxing the provisions of Regulation 22(3)(c) of the IEGC, 2023, which is preventing the Petitioner from conducting trial runs and commissioning its 50 MW Project in smaller tranches._ _2. Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Commission reserved the matter for order.”_ **11.** We have considered the submissions of Petitioner and Respondents and the documents placed on record. The following issue arises for our consideration:
title: Petition under Section 79(1)(c) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 57 and 58 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Indian Electricity Grid Code) Regulations, 2023 seeking relaxation of Regulation 22(3)(c) for permitting trial runs and commissioning of Wind Turbine Generators (WTGs) in tranches of at least 10 MW for the Petitioner's Wind Power Project. Powerica Limited
